person_made_it: Yes: a Palm Springs Googie motel est. 1970 for a man born in 1970, with rooms built on each friend's real lore (Joe's drop, Mason's Eagle passport, Alex's crown, Shannon's feast) and Gordon's own fourth seat.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Darby, as the motel's front desk, speaking to Gordon; quotes are only Gordon's own typed lines and friends' messages.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Desert night under a lit motel sign, with daylight postcards for each day.
did_the_click_pay_me: Yes: five distinct playable surprises with ElevenLabs sound, a Higgsfield finale video, chase lights, key fobs and confetti.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone width with no sideways scroll, sound off until tapped, reduced motion honored, private behind his login.
taught_me_something: The crew's history surfaces in play: the 55th Arenas crawl, the Eagle vow, Shannon's 'this is your life' menu.
told_me_the_truth: Yes: open items sit at the front desk; nothing invented about Joe at an Eagle.
weakest: Keys live on one phone; the crew cannot each tap from their own device yet.
